name: uav-ground-control-station
description: Local browser-based MAVLink ground control station for UAVs.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/server dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/web dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/target-estimation build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/desktop dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/server build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared test && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/target-estimation test && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/server test && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/target-estimation build && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/target-estimation typecheck && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @uav-ground-control-station/web typecheck
